Container.Name: TravStats
Container.Overview:
✈️ TravStats - Personal Flight Tracking & Statistics Dashboard
Track your flights, visualize routes on an interactive world map, and unlock achievements as you explore the world!
🌟 KEY FEATURES: • Interactive 2D/3D maps with flight paths and airport markers • 58 Battlefield-style achievements across 5 categories • Advanced statistics and analytics dashboard • CO2 footprint tracking and compensation suggestions • Boarding pass scanner with QR code support • Flight cost tracking with multi-currency support • Export to CSV, GeoJSON, KML (Google Earth) • Dark mode with theme persistence • RESTful API with JWT authentication • Mobile-friendly responsive UI
🔒 SECURITY FEATURES: • Auto-generated secure JWT secrets • Rate limiting on all endpoints • Duplicate flight detection • Production-ready with Pino structured logging
⚠️ REQUIREMENTS: This is an all-in-one container that includes both frontend and backend. PostgreSQL database is handled separately (see installation steps below).
📝 INSTALLATION: 1. Install PostgreSQL container first (postgis/postgis:15-3.4) 2. Set a strong database password 3. Install TravStats with the same password 4. Access at http://[IP]:[PORT]/ and create your account 5. Start tracking flights!
Version 1.0.0 - Production Ready ✅
Container.Requires:
🗄️ PostgreSQL 15 with PostGIS extension REQUIRED
STEP 1: Install PostgreSQL Database ===================================== Search for "postgis" in Community Apps and install: - Image: postgis/postgis:15-3.4 - Container Name: travstats-db - POSTGRES_DB: flights - POSTGRES_USER: flights - POSTGRES_PASSWORD: [CHOOSE A STRONG PASSWORD] - Port Mapping: 5432:5432 - Volume: /mnt/user/appdata/travstats-db → /var/lib/postgresql/data
STEP 2: Install TravStats (this container) =========================================== - Set "Database Password" to match PostgreSQL password - JWT secret will be auto-generated securely - Airport database seeds automatically on first start
⚙️ OPTIONAL: External API Keys ================================ For automatic flight data lookup, add: - AirLabs API Key (free tier: 1000 req/month) Get at: https://airlabs.co/
📚 Full documentation: https://github.com/Abrechen2/TravStats/blob/main/README.md

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port for accessing TravStats web interface

Config.Name: Database Password
Config.Description: PostgreSQL connection URL. Replace CHANGEME with your database password from Step 1.

Config.Name: AppData Volume
Config.Description: Persistent storage for auto-generated JWT secret and configuration files

Config.Name: Seed Airports Database
Config.Description: Automatically populate airports database with ~8000 airports on first start (recommended). Takes 1-2 minutes on first boot.

Config.Name: AirLabs API Key
Config.Description: Optional: AirLabs API key for automatic flight data lookup. Free tier: 1000 requests/month. Get at https://airlabs.co/

Config.Name: OpenSky Client ID
Config.Description: Optional: OpenSky Network OAuth Client ID for flight lookup fallback

Config.Name: OpenSky Client Secret
Config.Description: Optional: OpenSky Network OAuth Client Secret

Config.Name: Node Environment
Config.Description: Runtime environment. Leave as 'production' unless debugging.

Config.Name: Backend Port
Config.Description: Internal backend API port. Do not change.
